items.snippet:
what should I do when T2080 S1 Pro has E5A: Gyroscope abnormal, task ended. Click to contact customer service for assistance/Gyroscope error/No gyroscope data?
Restart the robot to see if it can be restored.

what should I do when T2080 S1 pro has E52: 3D MATRIX EYEsensor abnormal, task ended. Please try restarting or contact customer service for assistance/3D MATRIX EYE sensor error/3D MATRIX EYE sensor no data?
1. Check if there is any dirt on the 3D MATRIX EYE sensor and wipe it clean with a clean, soft cloth.
2. Restart the robot and see if the corresponding error message disappears.

what should I do when T2080 S1 pro has E53: TrueAl sensor abnormal, task ended. Please try restarting or contact customer service for assistance/A.I. sensor error/AI sensor has no data?
1. Check if there is any dirt on the 3D MATRIX EYE sensor and wipe it clean with a clean, soft cloth.
2. Restart the robot and see if the corresponding error message disappears.

what should I do when T2080 S1 Pro has E50: LiDAR abnormal, task ended. Please try restarting or contact customer service for assistance/Ladar error/No lidar data?
1. Restart the robot and see if the corresponding error message disappears.
2. Pick up the robot and check if there is a blue light rotating on the LiDAR.

what should I do when T2080 S1 pro has E13: Roller mop abnormal, task ended. Click to contact customer service for assistance/Rolling mop error/Abnormal roller mop?
Restart the robot and see if the corresponding error message disappears.

what should I do when T2080 S1 pro displays error E32: Wheels abnormal, task ended. Please try restarting or contact customer service for assistance/Robot wheels error/Wheel abnormality?
Please restart the robot to see if the corresponding error disappears. If the issue persists and you are within our warranty period, we will assist you with replacing the robot.

what should I do when T2080 S1 pro has Abnormal alert: E5G: Infrared obstacle avoidance sensor has no data. Click to contact customer service for assistance/No data from the infrared obstacle avoidance sensor
Restart the robot and unplug the base station power cord to restart and see if the corresponding error disappears.

what should I do when T2080 S1 pro has E21: Robot dirty water pump abnormal, task ended. Click to contact customer service for assistance/Robot dirty water pump error/Robot sewage pump component malfunction?
Restart the robot and see if the corresponding error message disappears.

What should I do when T2080 S1 Pro has E41: Battery abnormal, task ended. Please try restarting or contact customer service for assistance, or shows battery error?
1. Please update the robot firmware to the latest version in the APP.
2. Restart the robot and check if the robot works properly.
Applicable Models: T2080, S1 Pro
Applicable Error Codes or problem codes: E41
Core Symptoms: E41, Battery

what should I do when T2080 S1 pro has EB18: Base station solenoid valve abnormal, task ended. Click to contact customer service for assistance/Base station solenoid valve error/Base station solenoid valve malfunction?
Restart the robot and see if the corresponding error message disappears.

what should I do when T2080 S1 pro has EB19: Base station solenoid valve abnormal, task ended. Click to contact customer service for assistance/Base station solenoid valve error/Base station solenoid valve malfunction?
Restart the robot and see if the corresponding error message disappears.

what should I do when T2080 S1 Pro has E20: Robot clean water pump abnormal, task ended/Robot clean water pump error/Robot clean water pump component malfunction/The S1 Pro robot shows a warning E20: clean water pump abnormal, causing the task to end?
1. 1. Please use the app to update the firmware of the robot to the latest version.
2. After the upgrade, use the app to start the Base Station Mop

what should I do when T2080 S1 Pro has E58: Wall sensor abnormal, task ended.Please try restarting or contact customer service for assistance/Wall sensor error/Wall sensor no data?
Check whether the robot's wall sensor is dirty or obstructed by foreign objects. After cleaning, place it back on the ground to continue cleaning.

what should I do when T2080 S1 pro has EB34: Auto Water and Drainage Module clean water pump abnormal, task ended. Click to contactcustomer service for assistance/Clean water pump of Auto Water and Drainage Module is in error/Smart water replacement module clear water pump malfunction?
Restart the robot and see if the corresponding error message disappears.

what should I do when T2080 S1 pro has E5B: Lidar overheat, cleaning end, task ended. Click to contact customer service for assistance/Ladar module overheat/Laser Lidar overheating?
If your robot vacuum cleaner displays this prompt, it is generally due to normal overheating. The robot will automatically resume the last cleaning task after the temperature drops, without the need for task interventi
